title: Admissions Office Contact
aliases: who do I contact for admissions
content: The Director of Admissions is based in Room No. SRB-G30 on the VIT-AP campus (Beside AP Secretariat, Amaravati, 522241, Andhra Pradesh). Email: admission@vitap.ac.in. Phone: 0863 2370444, or 7901091283 for WhatsApp/mobile enquiries.

title: Registrar and General Enquiries
content: For general (non-admissions) enquiries, the Registrar's office can be reached at info@vitap.ac.in. The main campus address is VIT-AP University, Beside AP Secretariat, Amaravati, 522241, Andhra Pradesh.

title: Hyderabad Admissions Office
aliases: is there a VIT-AP office in Hyderabad
content: VIT-AP maintains an additional Admissions Office in Hyderabad: Unit No. 810/2, 7th Floor, Level 8, Vasavi MPM Grand, Yellareddyguda Road, Ameerpet, Hyderabad, 500072, Telangana. Email: admission@vitap.ac.in. Phone: 040 2955 9555, or 7901311658.

title: Quick Department Contacts
content: Quick reference for common departments: Career Development Centre (placements/internships) - placement@vitap.ac.in, 0863 2370219. Transport (day-scholar buses) - transportservice@vitap.ac.in, 7901091275. Centre of Examinations - helpdesk.coe@vitap.ac.in for general queries, transcript.services@vitap.ac.in for transcripts/certificates. Health Centre emergency ambulance - 7997965624. Admissions - admission@vitap.ac.in, 0863 2370444. For any department not listed here, use the Contact Us page or the Directory link on vitap.ac.in.
